title: These break easily
text: These break easily. An ice cube tray should last a long time, right?  Well I've gone through three sets of these in the last year or so because they develop cracks as soon as you use them.  I keep buying them because they're cheap at Target but I'm fed up.  I just threw away another pair which had around 5 cracks in them each after maybe three months of use.  I had one that cracked literally the very first time I used it.

product_metadata.title: Sterilite 72408012 Stacking Ice Cube Tray, White, 12-Pack
description: Keep your drinks cold with the Sterilite Stacking Ice Cube Tray. It is designed to channel water so the trays fill quickly and evenly. Multiple ice cube trays also stack neatly on top of the Ice Cube Bin to save space in the freezer while storing larger quantities of ice. The shape allows ice cubes to release with an easy twist. Other than water, this ice cube tray can be filled with other drinks, fruits, herbs and more to add a little flavor to your beverage. Sixteen, well-sized ice cubes form in each tray to ensure there is enough for many drinks at once. It is dishwasher safe, as well as BPA-free and phthalate-free. The overall assembled dimensions of this item are 13 1/8" L x 4 7/8" W x 1 5/8" H.
